contexts.text: They inspire into others, whom they hate, to murder them and afterwards accuse them as murderers.
Evil Spirits who are malignant and deceitful, insinuate themselves into the loves themselves... and presently... destroy the loves, and thus try to murder the man; and this by a thousand modes...
For when everyone wants... to be served, he murders the other in his heart.
Murders of the upright they esteemed as nothing.
More than the obsessed, they would rush into murders and rapines.
They rushed into the chambers of the brain, and injected terror, together with such insanity that the one killed the other.
There are some falsities which kill.
When he heard the Lord mentioned... he blazed with the murder of Him.
They consulted how they should murder me, and take life completely away from me. SE 2922. SE 3584.
It was disclosed that he had murdered him.
He had murdered the woman by magical art.
Another man who had appeared honest before all had murdered two men by magical art.

(Sarah Hesselia) had thought to murder me if she could; (and after her death) I wanted to kill myself with a knife... It is now disclosed that that woman was the Spirit who was excited whenever I saw the knife, and that she had held this so fixedly in my mind, from the hatred which she had taken against me.
Concerning those who enter into all the affections of man, and murder the affections. Explained.
Those who want to slay all, and who breathe bloodshed, and are never touched with any mercy, and who are proud in the highest degree, lie with swine.
Have afterwards contrived the murders of (these girls) in secret.

The Hells where the love of self reigns... continually breathe the murder of those who confess the Divine of the Lord; consequently, the murder of those who are in the good of love and the good of faith to the Lord from the Lord.

For enmity, hatred, and revenge, breathe murder, and will it; but they are held back... by the fear of the law, of resistance, and for reputation. Still, these three are endeavours after murder; and every endeavour is like an act; for it goes into act when the fear is removed. Signified.
